subject.title: feat: add editable voice dictation to the Control UI

question: Should editable Control UI dictation be accepted as a core Gateway/provider-backed feature with a new authenticated microphone-audio RPC?
rationale: The design is better aligned than direct browser Web Speech, but accepting a browser-to-Gateway transcription path is a product and security-boundary choice that code review cannot authorize by itself.

options.title: Continue After Proof And Port
options.body: Require the branch or replacement to port onto current main, fix the two concrete blockers, and provide successful redacted microphone-to-Gateway-to-editable-draft proof before merge.

options.title: Pause Behind The Feature Issue
options.body: Keep the paired feature issue open while maintainers decide whether this core dictation boundary belongs in OpenClaw now.

options.title: Reject Core Dictation For Now
options.body: Close or supersede this branch if maintainers prefer no core dictation surface or want future work routed through a different plugin/API direction.

recommendation.title: Continue After Proof And Port
recommendation.body: Require the branch or replacement to port onto current main, fix the two concrete blockers, and provide successful redacted microphone-to-Gateway-to-editable-draft proof before merge.
